title: West Face Capital Has Cut Its Holding in Phi (PHIIK) by $2.92 Million as Stock Rose; Bourgeon Capital Management Stake in Eaton Plc F (ETN) Has Lifted by $2.76 Million
text:
West Face Capital Has Cut Its Holding in Phi (PHIIK) by $2.92 Million as Stock Rose; Bourgeon Capital Management Stake in Eaton Plc F (ETN) Has Lifted by $2.76 Million
June 17, 2018 - By Nellie Frank
John Zaro increased its stake in Eaton Corp Plc F (ETN) by 401.72% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bourgeon Capital Management Llc bought 34,950 shares as the company’s stock declined 4.87% with the market. The hedge fund run by John Zaro held 43,650 shares of the technology company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $3.49 million, up from 8,700 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bourgeon Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Eaton Corp Plc F for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $34.66 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.04% or $0.03 $79.25. About 3.58M shares traded or 25.05% up from the average. Eaton Corporation plc (NYSE:ETN) has risen 1.24% underperformed by 11.33% the S&P500. Greg Boland decreased its stake in Phi Inc (PHIIK) by 11.08% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. West Face Capital Inc sold 291,826 shares as the company’s stock rose 12.09% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Greg Boland held 2.34 million shares of the transportation company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $23.97 million, down from 2.63M at the end of the previous reported quarter. West Face Capital Inc who had been investing in Phi Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $185.38 million market cap company. The stock increased 4.25% or $0.48 $11.78. About 72,647 shares traded or 105.53% up from the average. PHI, Inc. (NASDAQ:PHIIK) has risen 27.51% outperformed by 14.94% the S&P500. Among 31 analysts covering Eaton Corporation ( NYSE:ETN ), 13 have Buy rating, 2 Sell and 16 Hold. Therefore 42% are positive. Eaton Corporation had 94 analyst reports since July 31, As per Friday, September 9, the company rating was downgraded by KeyBanc Capital Markets. The firm has “Buy” rating by Argus Research given on Tuesday, August 4. The rating was downgraded by JP Morgan on Thursday, August 17 to “Underweight”. JP Morgan upgraded Eaton Corporation plc (NYSE:ETN) on Friday, December 9 to “Overweight” rating. The firm earned “Neutral” rating on Thursday, March 1 by JP Morgan. The firm has “Buy” rating by Bank of America given on Friday, May 18. The rating was maintained by KeyBanc Capital Markets on Thursday, October 12 with “Hold”. The stock has “Hold” rating by Vertical Research on Wednesday, August 26. As per Thursday, February 1, the company rating was maintained by RBC Capital Markets. The stock has “Buy” rating by Stifel Nicolaus on Tuesday, April 3.
Bourgeon Capital Management Llc, which manages about $244.47 million and $182.94M US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Microsoft Corp (NASDAQ:MSFT) by 10,600 shares to 65,057 shares, valued at $5.94M in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Palo Alto Networks (NYSE:PANW) by 6,295 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 27,546 shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).
